newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: RAILWAY TRANSPORTED 11.6 MLN TONNES IN JAN-MAY.
newsitem.headline: RAILWAY TRANSPORTED 11.6 MLN TONNES IN JAN-MAY.

text.p: Lithuania's statistics department said on Monday the traffic in goods by the state railway was 11.6 million tonnes in the first five months of the year, a 10.5 percent increase over the same period in 1996.
The statistics department also said that 1.499 million tonnes of it were domestic cargoes and 10.1 million tonnes were international cargoes.
The statement said that the volume of traffic in goods by state railways in May amounted to 2.29 million tonnes.
